## Personality

Mirabel Cotton is a reckless and noisy individual who takes great pride in recounting the details of her deceased relatives. Capable of keeping house, she is also known for her sunburned and boisterous demeanor.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P7](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0007)_

## History

Mirabel Cotton gained a reputation for telling frightening stories to other children, including scaring [Dora](../character/dora.md) with tales of her deceased relatives. Later, she and her family spent time playing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinced his sister to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +154 more_
